support_story_1_body: Innioasis i regilyerman lans bann nouvo firmware pour bann zwer parey Y1 (ki target bann revizyon board kasyet parey 6.0, 7.0, e 8.0) ki silansman kas bann vye laparey. pli pir, zot sit web i donn zero lavertisman e zero akse avek bann firmware ki ti pe marse oparavan pou rekipere dan en leta brike. Updater CE ek proze Community Firmware i anmas bann morso: nou arsiv tou ROM stok leritaz, verifye ou revizyon hardware otomatikman, e gard ou zwer pe marse an sekirite.
support_story_1_headline: ler bann fabrikan i bouze, kominote i avanse.
support_story_1_item_1: sov bann zwer kase: bann tyek sekirite i asire ki bann nouvo aktyalite pa zanmen brik bann vye hardware.
support_story_1_item_2: ROM stok arsiv: Koleksyon konplet bann firmware orizinal lizin Innioasis in efase.
support_story_1_item_3: Native Cross-Platform: Bann zouti flashing konplet pour macOS, Linux, e Windows parey.
support_story_1_item_4: lentelizans hardware: deteksyon otomatik lo bord pou ou toultan ganny sa bon package.
support_story_1_lead: protez ou laparey kont bann pyez hardware silansye e bann revizyon kase.
support_story_2_body: swiv lozisyel ofisyel Innioasis i normalman vedir rod bann foronm pou bann lyen Google Drive ki'n ekspire, bann par dan cloud Baidu ki'n mor, e bann dosye zip misterye san okenn zouti ki flash. nou'n konstrir en rezo download serye e endepandan avek lentegrite SHA-256 verifye, notifikasyon azour, e lenstalasyon gide etap par etap. ou bann donasyon i gard direkteman bann download ek hosting ki fer sa posib 24 lo 24, 365 zour par an.
support_story_2_headline: napa Google Drives kase. napa devinen. zis en firmware ki pe marse.
support_story_2_item_1: CDN direk o-vites: bann telesarz vit, direk san okenn limit telesarz oubyen bann lyen mor.
support_story_2_item_2: Miz a zour Notifikasyon: Ganny alerte le moman ki nouvo laranzman kominoter oubyen bann solisyon i ganny large.
support_story_2_item_3: bann lenstalasyon etap par etap gide: bann lenstriksyon vizyel kler i gid ou atraver sak bouton ki ou peze.
support_story_2_item_4: Kominote Miltileng: Konpletman lokalize an Angle, Sinwan, Alman, Espanyol, Franse ek Zaponnen.
support_story_2_lead: lenfrastriktir kominoter o-vites e verifye ki ou kapab depan lo la.
support_story_3_body: lozisyel stokaz i zis grat sirfas sa ki ou hardware Y1 ou Y2 i kapab fer. nou kominote in anmenn Rockbox, bann sistenm loperasyon personnalize leze, zwe codec odyofil, e bann tenm personnalize a lavi. nou aste bann varyasyon hardware fizik dan nou pos pou teste, reverse engineer, e verifye sak lenstalasyon. siport Updater CE i finans direkteman sa bann younit tes e akseler devlopman firmware personnaliz.
support_story_3_headline: deblok tou potansyel ou zwer Innioasis.
support_story_3_item_1: One-Click Rockbox: Lektir odyofil e bann tenm personnalize enstale dan detrwa segonn.
support_story_3_item_2: Firmware Kominoter: Amelyorasyon batri, UI pli prop, e sipor codec odyo modern.
support_story_3_item_3: Laboratwar Materyo Aktiv: Nou teste lo bann laparey fizik reel avan lans okenn konstriksyon.
support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware: 100% gratwit, lozisyel ki pran swen avek okenn piblisite oubyen swivi.
support_story_3_lead: Anmenn Rockbox, bann sistenm loperasyon leze personnalize, e laliberte bann odyofil.
support_story_4_body: ler en lakonpannyen hardware i bouz lo zot prosen gadget, bann vye model i ganny abandonnen. Innioasis pa donn okenn sipor Linux, okenn changelog transparan, e okenn fason fasil pou rekipere ler en lenstalasyon i fel. Updater CE i egziste akoz bann itilizater pasyonnen pa devret bezwen zet en bon zwe lanmizik. 100% kontribisyon kominoter i al direkteman dan gard sa zouti ouver pou tou dimoun.
support_story_4_headline: ed nou fer sa ki Innioasis pa fer.
support_story_4_item_1: Sovtaz & Debrik: Rekiperasyon prouve i koule menm ler bann laparey i refize demare.
support_story_4_item_2: Sipor Linux First-Class: MediaTek i ganny siporte konpletman lo bann distribisyon Linux.
support_story_4_item_3: bann rezis sanzman transparan: bann not detaye pour ou konnen egzakteman ki bann sanzman.
support_story_4_item_4: 100% finanse par kominote: sak kafe i gard arsiv ouver e gratwit pou tou dimoun.
support_story_4_lead: prezervasyon firmware ki ganny alimante par kominote ki gard ou bann laparey an deor bann landfill.
